title: 1217 Western Lake Drive Vacation Rental
meta_description: 1217 Western Lake Drive is a 5.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Tucked within WaterColor’s scenic Camp District, 1217 Western Lake Drive offers the perfect balance of refined comfort, family-friendly design, and prime location. With a 6-passenger electric cart, six adult bikes, and Beach Club access for up to 12 guests, this home is an exceptional retreat for those seeking space, style, and relaxation on 30A.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 12 Passes Included 6-Passenger Electric Cart 6 Adult Bikes Included Parking for 2 Vehicles (Garage Access Available) Natural Gas Grill Exterior Shower Large Screened Porches 3 Fireplaces 2 Living Areas 4-Minute Walk to Camp WaterColor 6-Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club 5-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Welcome to 1217 Western Lake Drive, where coastal design and modern comfort meet in perfect harmony. The first floor opens with a beautifully furnished living room featuring a large flat-screen television above a stone fireplace and ample seating in soft linen textures. The gourmet kitchen is designed for both style and function, equipped with stainless-steel appliances, granite countertops, and a large bar that seats ten. Custom lighting and designer details create a bright and welcoming space ideal for family meals or entertaining. Just beyond the kitchen, a screened-in porch offers additional dining and lounge space complete with a fireplace and television, perfect for morning coffee or evening gatherings. Two guest bedrooms are located on this level one with a king bed and private bath, and another with a queen bed and private bath. A convenient half bath and laundry area complete the first-floor layout. The second floor opens to a spacious family room that provides an ideal setting for children or additional guests to enjoy a movie or quiet reading time. A full-over-full bunk room with a pull-out trundle and private bath offers a playful retreat for younger guests. The primary suite features a king bed and a luxurious en- suite bathroom with a walk-in shower. French doors open to an expansive screened balcony furnished with a porch swing bed, wet bar, refrigerator, and a third fireplace with a mounted television, creating a serene space to unwind after a day in the sun. The separate carriage house provides additional privacy and flexibility with a queen bedroom, private bath, and a convenient kitchenette, perfect for extended family or friends. With its multiple living areas, generous outdoor spaces, and thoughtful amenities, 1217 Western Lake Drive delivers a true WaterColor experience filled with comfort, style, and connection.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-In ShowerGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-In ShowerHalf BathroomLaundry AreaSecond Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-In ShowerGuest Bedroom: Full-Over-Full Bunk Bed with Full Pull-Out Trundle, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboLiving Area: Queen Sleeper SofaHalf BathroomCarriage House Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-In ShowerLife in WaterColor Located just one block from Camp WaterColor, this home places guest just steps away from one of the community’s most popular amenities. Take a short bike or electric cart ride to the Beach Club, Seaside, or the WaterColor Tennis Center, and enjoy convenient access to scenic trails and dining. 1217 Western Lake Drive offers the perfect blend of luxury, location, and relaxation for an unforgettable coastal getaway.
